warmup.description: Ease into movement with gradual pacing to prepare for controlled, adaptive cardio effort.
movements: Easy walk or cycle x 2 minutes
Gradual pace increase to light effort x 2 minutes

main_exercises.name: Phase-Adjusted Steady Cardio
main_exercises.load_guidance: Maintain effort between zone 2 and low zone 3 (60-75%), adjusting pace based on energy levels and perceived exertion throughout
main_exercises.form_cue: Continuously check in with your body and adjust pace to keep breathing controlled and sustainable

cooldown.description: Gradually lower heart rate and transition into recovery with calm breathing.
movements: Slow walk or easy cycle x 2 minutes

phase_notes.menstrual: Keep effort closer to zone 2 and reduce pace if needed—this session should feel supportive, not draining. Focus on gentle consistency.
phase_notes.follicular: You can naturally drift toward the higher end of the effort range—maintain a steady rhythm and use this session to build aerobic consistency.
phase_notes.ovulatory: You may feel capable of higher output, but keep effort controlled within moderate range—focus on smooth pacing rather than pushing intensity.
phase_notes.early_luteal: Maintain a steady, moderate effort and avoid spikes in intensity—this session is ideal for sustaining routine without overexertion.
phase_notes.late_luteal: Adjust effort downward if needed and prioritize comfort—keep the session consistent but gentle to support energy and recovery.
